column1: # Official cloud images the end-to-end tests boot, one per supported system.
# Each image is checked against the checksum file published next to it before use.
# Columns (tab separated): id, label, image URL, checksum file URL, algorithm
# {build} (Debian): a dated build folder such as 20261111-2659, which never changes once published.
# The harness lists the builds in the folder above it and takes the newest one whose image is in
# its checksum file and downloads with that checksum, else the build before. Not latest/: Debian
# rewrites it in place while it publishes a build, so it can lack the image (issue #212).
